description: Measures peak half-precision (FP16) floating-point compute throughput using packed __hfma2() intrinsics on __half2 values. Each __hfma2 delivers 4 FLOPs (2 packed elements x 2 ops). Emits per-iteration GPU event time and host time records (total = sum of kernel times); GFLOPS is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: fmas_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of __hfma2 operations per thread per kernel invocation; controls total compute work

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
